item.title: Gero Onsen: One of Japan's Three Great Hot Springs — Guide
item.description: Gero Onsen has been ranked among Japan’s three greatest hot springs since the Edo period, prized for its smooth, skin-softening alkaline waters, and sits in a scenic river valley conveniently located on the rail line between Nagoya and Takayama. The town is built around the Hida River, lined with ryokan and public bathhouses, and offers several free foot baths scattered along the streets and riverbank, plus a riverside open-air bath, making it easy to sample the famous waters whether staying overnight or passing through.
